ns2:section.sectionText: BCOG/PSYC Seniors (90 hrs earned) registration begins on April 6; BCOG/PSYC Juniors (60 hrs earned) registration begins on April 13. Restrictions lifted on April 15 @ 5:00 pm. This course will review research into human decision making and judgment, with a special emphasis on the cognitive processes that underlie decisions. Prerequisite of PSYC 224 or PSYC 248 and an introductory statistics class required. **Elective course for course for BCOG major or Cognitive and Intradisciplinary Psychology Concentration**
